summary: The complete Science supplement contains scRNA-seq expression summaries by neuronal cluster and MERFISH images of selected sex-related genes. None reports a gene-level male-versus-female effect across all submitted preoptic cells in the six registered scRNA-seq pools. Table S1 confirms the library assignments, although GEO and the supplementary methods disagree on the number of mice per pool.

manualReview.summary: Author cluster and spatial results recovered. The aggregate preoptic sex contrast has no comparable author estimate.
manualReview.note: All nine attachments listed by PMC and BioStudies were recovered and inspected, covering Tables S1–S11 and Figures S1–S22. All 31,299 Table S1 barcodes match GEO, and their sex and replicate assignments reconcile to the six registered pools. Table S2 summarizes expression within neuronal clusters. Figure S8 shows MERFISH images of 11 selected genes from two male and two female animals. The Dryad deposit contains per-cell MERFISH measurements. The reviewed sources provide no author effect, raw P or FDR for the registered all-cell sex contrast.
reviewFlags: GEO and ENA describe three mice per sequencing pool. The scRNA-seq methods on supplement p. 2 report four to five per sex per replicate. The exact donor count for each library remains unresolved.
Author effect concordance and inference for male_vs_female remain unassessed.

verificationReview.reason: Table S2 reports gene means, 95th percentiles and detection fractions by neuronal cluster. The paper's cluster abundance, targeted MERFISH sex images and Dryad spatial expression data also concern different outcomes or animals. None supplies a full or selected gene-level author effect for the six-pool, all-cell male-versus-female scRNA-seq contrast.
verificationReview.nextStep: Reopen the numerical review if an author gene-level estimate for these same libraries and all preoptic cell types becomes available. To reconcile the donor metadata, ask how many mice contributed cells to each of GSM3109253–GSM3109258.
